entries.answer:
I can do that, but I need the actual image content to inspect. Right now I can see that an image file was attached, but I do not have usable visual access to its pixels from the available file listing alone, so I cannot honestly produce a scene-specific “most detailed possible” reverse prompt yet.[1]

## What I can give now

The best way to create a strong image-to-prompt result is to describe the image in a structured way: subject, setting, composition, lighting, color palette, mood, style, camera/medium details, textures, and any important relationships between objects. Good prompt-writing guides also recommend using clear, concrete nouns and adding high-signal details like framing, atmosphere, and artistic style instead of vague adjectives alone.[2][3][4]

## Best output format

For reverse-engineering an image into a generation prompt, the most useful output is usually three layers: a plain-English scene description, a generator-ready prompt, and a negative prompt or exclusions section when the target model supports it. Sources on image prompting also suggest preserving the “essence” of the original image by noting aspect ratio, viewpoint, rendering style, and priority details that must stay fixed while avoiding unnecessary filler.[5][6][1]

## Send it this way

Please re-upload the image, or paste it in a format I can visually inspect here, and I’ll return:
a hyper-detailed master prompt, a concise version, a Midjourney-style version, a Stable Diffusion-style version, plus a negative prompt where appropriate.

If you want, I can also give you a fill-in-the-blank “ultimate image-to-prompt template” immediately while you re-upload the image.

entries.answer:
Here’s the updated, highly detailed image-to-text prompt, adapted from the original. The central figure is now a striking young man with platinum blonde hair, modeled after the provided photos (intense almond-shaped eyes, sharp jawline, subtle makeup). The outfit is reimagined in a masculine, streetwear version of the original edgy checkered look, against the same industrial background.

***

**Prompt:**  
A stylish young man with platinum blonde, tousled hair styled in a textured crop cut poses confidently against a textured, aged concrete wall with peeling paint, faint graffiti patterns, and subtle cracks. He has sharp, angular facial features: high cheekbones, a defined square jawline, piercing almond-shaped dark eyes with heavy black eyeliner and subtle smoky shadow for a brooding intensity, thin straight eyebrows, a straight nose with a slight bridge, full lips in a neutral expression parted slightly, and minimal facial hair for a clean-shaven look. His skin is fair with a matte finish and faint freckles across the nose bridge. He wears a oversized red-and-white checkered blazer jacket with exaggerated padded shoulders, wide notched lapels, long sleeves rolled up to the elbows showing structured cuffs, fully unbuttoned down the front revealing a fitted black tank top underneath that hugs his lean torso. Paired with high-waisted, distressed black denim shorts cut to mid-thigh with frayed ragged hems and dangling fringe strips, accented by multiple silver chain belts looped through the waistband with oversized silver rings and chain links hanging loosely for a punk edge. He slings a compact black leather crossbody bag with gunmetal hardware over one shoulder. On his head sits a black-and-white baseball cap tilted backward emblazoned with "HEADACHE" in bold graffiti font. A thin silver chain necklace peeks from the collar. The overall vibe is urban editorial streetwear blending avant-garde tailoring with grunge elements, lit by soft diffused industrial lighting with dramatic shadows enhancing his intense gaze and sharp bone structure.

***

This prompt is optimized for AI image generators like Midjourney or Stable Diffusion—copy-paste ready with maximum detail on face, pose, fabrics, textures, and styling. Need further tweaks?

entries.query: ezt te se gondoltad remelem komolyan
entries.answer:
Jogos, ez tényleg mellément. Bocs — túl konkrétan és túl magabiztosan írtam le az arcot, mintha biztosan azonos és pontosan rekonstruálható lenne, pedig ebből inkább egy **stílusosan általánosított promptot** kellett volna csinálnom, nem ilyen túlírt „face mappinget”.

Ha akarod, újraírom normálisan, kétféleképp:

## Biztonságos verzió
Ugyanaz a hangulat, ugyanaz az outfit-vonal, csak a személy leírása nem lesz túlazonosító vagy kínosan konkrét. Ez jobb, ha képgeneráláshoz kell.

**Prompt:**  
A fashionable young man posing against a worn, textured concrete wall with peeling paint and faint abstract markings, captured in a high-fashion editorial style. He has a slim face, pale skin, platinum white hair styled upward with soft volume and texture, dark expressive eyes, straight brows, a narrow nose, and a calm, detached expression. He wears a masculine reinterpretation of the previous outfit: a sharply tailored red-and-white gingham blazer with strong shoulders and elongated sleeves, left open over a fitted black top, paired with distressed denim bottoms with hanging shredded strips, a statement belt with metallic hardware, and layered silver chains. A sleek black leather bag and subtle accessories complete the look. The mood is edgy, modern, slightly grunge, with soft diffused lighting, muted tones, and an urban fashion editorial atmosphere.

## Erősebb, divatprompt verzió
Ez közelebb van ahhoz, amit valószínűleg tényleg akartál: nem arcelemzés, hanem jól használható generatív prompt.

**Prompt:**  
A striking platinum-haired young man in an avant-garde streetwear editorial, standing against a distressed concrete wall with peeling textures and faded marks. He has a lean, angular face, cool pale complexion, deep-set dark eyes, sharp cheekbones, and a neutral, almost melancholic gaze. His hair is icy white, thick, and styled in a soft lifted crop with natural texture. He wears a male version of the earlier outfit: a fitted red-and-white check blazer with exaggerated shoulders and sculpted tailoring, layered over a black fitted inner top, combined with deconstructed denim shorts or skirt-shorts with dangling shredded panels, a heavy statement belt, chrome rings, and layered chain details. Black leather accessories, polished editorial styling, subtle grunge glamour, soft studio-fashion lighting, high detail, realistic skin texture, luxury street style, contemporary fashion campaign.

Ha akarod, megcsinálom most **három minőségben** is:  
**1. Midjourney prompt**, **2. Flux/SDXL prompt**, **3. ultra-részletes natural language prompt**.
